name: transparent pool-scoped fee reaches structural prototype readiness
description: A fixed hook-owned swap charge covers every swap quadrant, settles atomically and records immutable PoolId-scoped beneficiary liabilities without an administrator redirect.

model.name: Transparent Pool-Scoped Fee
model.summary: Collect one immutable ten-basis-point swap charge for the launch wallet while keeping every liability isolated by PoolId and currency.
model.userOutcome: A creator can launch a WETH-paired token with one visible fee, an immutable beneficiary and a permissionless view of accrued and claimed balances.
model.whyV4: The afterSwap callback can debit the exact unspecified currency, settle the hook delta and record the matching beneficiary liability atomically.

feesAndClaims.actor: The authenticated PoolManager callback accrues fees; only the immutable beneficiary can claim its own balance.
feesAndClaims.valueFlow: Each swap charge moves from the caller delta into the hook contract and credits one PoolId, currency and beneficiary liability.
feesAndClaims.custody: The hook contract contains only collected fee assets; canonical pool liquidity is never counted as backing for a beneficiary claim.
feesAndClaims.failure: Fee settlement and liability accounting are atomic with the swap; a failed claim leaves both the liability and token balance unchanged.
feesAndClaims.event: Emit FeeAccrued for each charge and FeeClaimed for each successful beneficiary withdrawal.

pool.orderingRule: Mine the launched-token CREATE2 salt until its predicted address sorts after the fixed mainnet WETH address; otherwise rebuild the PoolKey.

callbackPolicies.necessity: The callback computes one bounded charge from the completed swap's unspecified currency and records its beneficiary liability.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: Only invalid PoolId admission, arithmetic bounds, settlement failure or an atomic liability write may revert the complete swap.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: The callback affects swaps only; standard liquidity removal remains available and beneficiary claims cannot block another user.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: PoolManager take does not initiate another swap, liquidity action or callback to this hook.

feeMechanism.chargedCurrency: The unspecified swap currency: gross output for exact-input swaps and gross input for exact-output swaps.

zeroForOneExactInput.formula: floor(gross currency1 output times 1000 divided by 1000000)

zeroForOneExactOutput.formula: ceil(net PoolManager currency0 input times 1000 divided by (1000000 minus 1000))

oneForZeroExactInput.formula: floor(gross currency0 output times 1000 divided by 1000000)

oneForZeroExactOutput.formula: ceil(net PoolManager currency1 input times 1000 divided by (1000000 minus 1000))

feeMechanism.collectionEvent: FeeAccrued(bytes32 indexed poolId,address indexed currency,address indexed beneficiary,uint256 amount)
feeMechanism.ownership: The launch transaction sender is recorded once as the sole beneficiary; no administrator, factory or operator can redirect accrued value.
feeMechanism.claimPolicy: Only the recorded beneficiary may claim its own PoolId and currency balance; the claim transfers to that immutable address after decrementing the liability.

customAccounting.backingSource: Each fee debit is taken with claims=false into the hook contract before its matching beneficiary liability is credited.
customAccounting.conservationEquation: For every currency, the hook contract token balance must be at least the sum of liabilities across all PoolId and beneficiary keys for that currency.
customAccounting.settlement: afterSwap returns one positive unspecified-currency delta, takes the exact amount from PoolManager into the hook contract and records the same amount in the beneficiary ledger before returning.
customAccounting.partialFillBehavior: The fee is calculated only from the final executed swap amount; an unfilled amount creates neither a charge nor a liability.
customAccounting.liabilityNamespace: Each liability key is keccak256(modelVersion, PoolId, currency, beneficiary), and every view, accrual and claim uses the same key.
customAccounting.duplicateCurrencyPolicy: Two pools using the same currency share a gross contract balance but retain separate PoolId liabilities; neither pool can spend or claim another pool's attribution.
customAccounting.failureIsolation: Any failed take, ledger update or token transfer reverts the complete action; no catch path records an unfunded liability or consumes another PoolId balance.
customAccounting.withdrawalOrdering: A claim checks msg.sender against the immutable beneficiary, decrements only that exact liability, transfers the exact currency amount and reverts the decrement if transfer fails.

afterSwap.backingSource: The hook takes the exact positive delta from PoolManager with claims=false before the callback returns and then records the equal beneficiary liability.

unspecified.formula: The fixed ten-basis-point fee calculated from the executed quadrant basis and capped below the executed amount.
unspecified.maximum: the lower of the immutable ten-basis-point cap and the nonzero executed amount minus one base unit

positiveSettlementActions.amountRule: Take exactly the positive unspecified-currency delta returned by afterSwap with claims=false.
Credit the same taken amount to the exact PoolId, currency and beneficiary liability.

afterSwap.bounds: The return delta is nonnegative, never exceeds ten basis points of the executed quadrant basis and cannot consume the complete executed amount.
afterSwap.rounding: Exact-input output charges round down; exact-output input surcharges round up, with checked uint256 to int128 conversion.
afterSwap.slippageOrMinimums: The router applies minimum output or maximum input to the final caller delta after the hook charge, not to a pre-fee quote.
afterSwap.failureRule: A zero executed amount returns zero; any cap, conversion, take or ledger failure reverts the entire swap before unlock ends.
afterSwap.executionEvent: FeeAccrued(bytes32 indexed poolId,address indexed currency,address indexed beneficiary,uint256 amount)

valueFlows.asset: the unspecified WETH or launched-token currency for the executed swap quadrant
valueFlows.from: the final caller swap delta after core execution
valueFlows.to: the hook contract balance attributed to the immutable launch beneficiary
valueFlows.amountRule: Charge ten basis points of gross output for exact input or gross input for exact output, using the declared rounding rule and immutable cap.
valueFlows.settlement: The afterSwap positive delta debits the caller, PoolManager take with claims=false cancels the hook credit and the internal ledger records the equal beneficiary liability.
valueFlows.failure: Any arithmetic, take or ledger failure reverts the complete swap and leaves no fee or liability behind.

valueFlows.asset: the exact currency selected by the PoolId and beneficiary liability key
valueFlows.amountRule: Transfer no more than the caller's recorded liability for the selected PoolId and currency.
valueFlows.settlement: Checks and effects precede the ERC-20 transfer; a failed transfer reverts the liability decrement.
valueFlows.failure: An unauthorized caller, zero claim or transfer failure reverts without changing another key.

operations.monitoring: Index FeeAccrued and FeeClaimed by PoolId, currency and beneficiary; alert when confirmed gross balances fall below reconstructed liabilities.
operations.incidentResponse: The immutable hook has no pause, rescue or redirect authority; stop new launches and publish exact affected PoolIds if a solvency mismatch is confirmed.

integration.partialFills: Use only the final executed amount reported by PoolManager; unfilled input or output is excluded from both the fee basis and liability.
integration.slippage: Quotes and execution apply the hook charge before enforcing the user's final minimum output or maximum input.
events: FeeAccrued(bytes32 indexed poolId,address indexed currency,address indexed beneficiary,uint256 amount)
FeeClaimed(bytes32 indexed poolId,address indexed currency,address indexed beneficiary,uint256 amount)

dataReconstruction.eventCoverage: FeeAccrued reconstructs every PoolId, currency and beneficiary liability increase; FeeClaimed reconstructs every decrease; confirmed token balances reconcile backing.
dataReconstruction.reconciliation: At one confirmed block, compare event-derived liabilities with claimable views and each currency balance; quarantine stale or undercollateralized results.

balanceSources: ERC-20 balanceOf(hook) for WETH and each launched token at one confirmed block
liabilitySources: FeeAccrued and FeeClaimed logs plus claimable(poolId,currency,beneficiary) contract reads
reserveReconstruction.solvencyEquation: For each currency, confirmed ERC-20 balanceOf(hook) must be greater than or equal to the sum of all reconstructed PoolId and beneficiary liabilities.
reserveReconstruction.donationAndDustPolicy: A direct token transfer creates no beneficiary liability and is excluded from claimable amounts; no administrator can sweep or attribute the excess.
reserveReconstruction.reconciliation: Rebuild liabilities from finalized events, compare them with claimable views and gross balances, and withhold results whenever any value disagrees.

targets: The exact WETH or launched-token ERC-20 address stored in the selected liability key
callSites: claim(poolId,currency) transfers the selected accrued balance after its liability is decremented
externalCalls.reentrancyPolicy: The claim entry point is non-reentrant and follows checks, effects and interaction; callbacks cannot observe an unchanged claimable balance.
externalCalls.stateDriftPolicy: Only standard WETH and the immutable fixed-supply launch token are supported; the transfer must reduce the exact selected contract balance by the claimed amount.
externalCalls.returnValuePolicy: Use SafeERC20 and require a successful standard ERC-20 transfer or revert the complete claim.
externalCalls.failureAtomicity: A reverted or malformed token transfer reverts the prior liability decrement and cannot change another PoolId, currency or beneficiary key.

rationales.complexity: The model combines one afterSwap delta, exact PoolManager settlement, a beneficiary ledger and a claim path.
rationales.customMath: The only arithmetic is a fixed bounded basis-point calculation with explicit directional rounding.
rationales.externalDependencies: Claims call the exact standard WETH or immutable launched-token contract through SafeERC20.
rationales.externalLiquidity: No external inventory, vault or third-party collateral backs the accrued fee liabilities.
rationales.valueAtRisk: Collected fees remain in the immutable hook contract until the recorded beneficiary claims them.
rationales.teamMaturity: A conservative nonzero process score remains until independent accounting and security reviews finish.
rationales.upgradeability: The hook, fee rate, beneficiary binding and liability namespace are immutable for the pool.
rationales.autonomy: No keeper, oracle, scheduler or autonomous parameter can change the fee or move a beneficiary balance.
rationales.priceImpact: The bounded charge changes the caller's final input or output but never replaces core price formation.

disclosures: This proposal is not deployed, reviewed or available through Programmable.
The fee is separate from the pool LP fee and belongs only to the immutable launch beneficiary.
The hook cannot redirect a beneficiary, change the fee, use pool liquidity as backing or claim another PoolId balance.
